entities.name: Rüfət Hüseynov
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Rufat Huseynov is an Azerbaijani boxer. He competed in the men's light flyweight event at the 2016 Summer Olympics. He previously won the gold medal at the 2014 Summer Youth Olympics in the men's light flyweight.
